extraFacts.fact: Thorburn model codes in the exotic-alloy and stainless listings: 95 is an unbraided core, 96 a single braid and 96Z a double braid in the same alloy.
extraFacts.source: Indus Hydraulics listings for Thorburn hoses (titles and construction fields)

extraFacts.fact: Corrugated metal hose terms: annular corrugation is a series of parallel rings (versus helical, a continuous spiral); braid is a woven wire sleeve that contains pressure; ISO 10380 covers corrugated metal hoses and hose assemblies, with a safety factor of 4:1 on burst pressure as quoted in the listings; hoses are hydrotested at 1.5 times working pressure.
extraFacts.source: ISO 10380 (corrugated metal hoses and hose assemblies); manufacturer listings

faqs.q: What is the Hose Master Hastelloy C276 Annular Hose (Annuflex Series) used for?
faqs.a: The Hose Master Hastelloy C276 Annular Hose (Annuflex Series) is a Hastelloy C276 annular corrugated metallic hose. Typical uses include north American severe sour-gas projects, US chemical / refinery service and acidic process plant. See the [exotic alloy hoses](/c/metallic-exotic-alloy-hoses).

faqs.q: Which standards apply to the Hose Master Hastelloy C276 Annular Hose (Annuflex Series)?
faqs.a: The Hose Master Hastelloy C276 Annular Hose (Annuflex Series) lists several standards and certificates. Listed: ISO 10380:2012 (Corrugated Metal Hoses and Hose Assemblies); Pressure Equipment Directive 2014/68/EU Module H; ASME B31.3 Class 2 (Hastelloy); NACE MR0175 / ISO 15156 (sour-service compliant); EN 10204 3.1 / 3.2 mill test reports on request. Ask on your request for the certificates the project needs and we confirm what is available before supply.

faqs.q: What sizes does the Hose Master Hastelloy C276 Annular Hose (Annuflex Series) come in?
faqs.a: The Hose Master Hastelloy C276 Annular Hose (Annuflex Series) is listed with a nominal ID range of DN 13 (1/2") to DN 200 (8"). Minimum bend radius is 50 / 200 mm minimum (static / dynamic) with the OEM figures; confirm the size on your request.

faqs.q: What pressure and temperature can the Hose Master Hastelloy C276 Annular Hose (Annuflex Series) take?
faqs.a: The Hose Master Hastelloy C276 Annular Hose (Annuflex Series) has working pressure to 125 bar at the smallest bore; operating temperature -200°C to +540°C. Working pressure 125 bar (smallest bore, single braid configuration) — derates with increasing diameter and temperature per the OEM datasheet. Burst pressure 500 bar minimum, safety factor 4:1 per ISO 10380. Pressure falls as bore and temperature rise, so give the full duty.

faqs.q: What is the Hose Master Hastelloy C276 Annular Hose (Annuflex Series) made of?
faqs.a: The Hose Master Hastelloy C276 Annular Hose (Annuflex Series) has core material Hastelloy C276, braid Single Braid — Type 304 SS and end fitting material 316L SS standard; Hastelloy fittings on request. Construction type: exotic Alloy Annular — Hastelloy C276 single-braid annular (Hose Master Annuflex).

faqs.q: is the Hose Master Hastelloy C276 Annular Hose (Annuflex Series) suitable for sour-service (H₂S) wells?
faqs.a: Yes — Hastelloy C276 is fully NACE MR0175 / ISO 15156 compliant for sour-service exposure. Body, trim, and braid (where applicable) meet the NACE hardness and chemistry limits. Provide a partial-pressure data sheet with H₂S, CO₂, and chloride values and we will confirm trim suitability and any service limits.

faqs.q: What do I send to order the Hose Master Hastelloy C276 Annular Hose (Annuflex Series)?
faqs.a: To order the Hose Master Hastelloy C276 Annular Hose (Annuflex Series), confirm (a) line working pressure and process medium (specify chemistry, temperature. And any concentration limits — exotic-alloy selection depends critically on the corrosion envelope), (b) operating temperature range, (c) bore size and overall length, (d) end fitting style and matching alloy preference (matched-alloy fittings are recommended for severe service; SS fittings reduce cost where corrosion permits), (e) braid count (drives pressure rating), (f) any required certifications.

faqs.q: What bend radius and weight does the Hose Master Hastelloy C276 Annular Hose (Annuflex Series) have?
faqs.a: The Hose Master Hastelloy C276 Annular Hose (Annuflex Series) lists a minimum bend radius of 50 / 200 mm minimum and a weight of ~0.32 kg/m (size-dependent). Keep the bend radius above the minimum, and do not twist the hose in service.

faqs.q: Hose Master Hastelloy C276 Annular Hose (Annuflex Series): why Hastelloy C276 over stainless steel?
faqs.a: Hastelloy C276 (UNS N10276) is a nickel-molybdenum-chromium-tungsten alloy with exceptional resistance to oxidising and reducing acid environments — including hot chloride, sulphuric, phosphoric, and chlorine-bleach service. It significantly outperforms 316L SS in sour H₂S service and pitting / crevice corrosion in chloride brines.
